summary_md: **HOPE. ([@rlaope](https://x.com/rlaope/status/2114998833713443212))** introduces **deepseek-bot**, an agentic memory layer and messenger gateway for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): an always-on teammate for Slack, Discord and Telegram that remembers threads, drafts documents and asks before deleting anything. MIT-licensed, installed with a one-line script per the README screenshot.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - rlaope/deepseek-bot: The agentic memory & gateway for deepseek-harness

relevance: Shows how a CLI agent harness gets extended into a persistent, chat-connected personal agent with memory.

media.description: README header of the rlaope/deepseek-bot GitHub repo: an always-on AI teammate for Slack, Discord and Telegram built on DeepSeek Harness, with curl install and 'dsh gateway setup' commands.
media.ocr_text: deepseek-bot. An always-on AI teammate for Slack, Discord and Telegram, built on DeepSeek Harness. It remembers your threads, reads what you send it, drafts documents, and asks before it deletes anything. Install: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rlaope/deepseek-bot/master/install.sh | bash; dsh # talk to it in the terminal; dsh gateway setup # connect Slack, Telegram or Discord
